title: Towards Patronizing and Condescending Language in Chinese Videos: A Multimodal Dataset and Detector

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating and detecting Patronizing and Condescending Language (PCL) in Chinese videos targeting disabled individuals by developing a multimodal dataset (PCLMM) and training a cross-modality fusion detector (MultiPCL) using text, audio, video, and facial expression features, alongside evaluating toxicity and sentiment.

Annotating and detecting Patronizing and Condescending Language (PCL) in Chinese videos targeting women by developing a multimodal dataset (PCLMM) and training a cross-modality fusion detector (MultiPCL) using text, audio, video, and facial expression features, alongside evaluating toxicity and sentiment.
